tasafPayment.museSettings.saveNote: Changes apply only after another user approves them.
tasafPayment.museSettings.pendingBanner: A change by {user} is awaiting approval. The form shows the values in use and is locked until it is approved, rejected or cancelled.
tasafPayment.museSettings.environmentMis: These settings were approved on server “{approved}”, but this server is “{server}”. They may have come with a database copy — review and re-approve them before any payment is sent.
tasafPayment.museSettings.helpText.1: These values come from MUSE (Ministry of Finance) and go into every payment message TASAF MIS sends: the institution, the account debited, the budget classes, the description and, if MUSE asks for them, the GL lines. The currency is always TZS.
tasafPayment.museSettings.helpText.2: A change is not applied when you submit it. It waits in “Changes” below until another user with the approve right approves it; the person who submitted it cannot approve it. Only one change can wait at a time — approve, reject or cancel it before submitting another.
tasafPayment.museSettings.helpText.3: FSP bank names, channels and BICs are edited under Charges ▸ FSP providers and go through the same approval; they are listed here too.
tasafPayment.museSettings.helpText.4: Each server has a label (TEST or LIVE). If the settings in use were approved on a different server — for example after a database was copied — a red warning appears here and on the MUSE message preview.
